summary: The current implementation fully achieves the saved MCP read-only operator parity plan: explicit MCP tools cover merge queue, workspace overview, validation provenance, stale reasons, artifact metadata, failure/workspace/resource/SLO metrics, operations, and overlap graph; REST remains canonical through shared service builders and REST-compatible schemas/reason codes; missing read-only resources return null while invalid cursors return structured INVALID_CURSOR errors; no arbitrary shell or Docker exec surface was added. Validation passed: focused MCP parity tests, full MCP tests, focused REST API tests, ruff, mypy, full unit suite, and the 99% coverage gate at 99.04%.
